title: P1.11a Persist submitted goal briefs through a production command
description: The current default Create goal surface lacks a goal-bound backend contract. Existing foreign UI WIP stores draft prose only as advisory intake before replaying a fixed affordance. Measure the current daemon/contracts/client surfaces and add the minimum authenticated production command that validates and durably persists the submitted title/instructions as the created goal or planning input, returning stable success/refusal receipts.
definitionOfDone: Verify-or-block first: name the existing durable goal/planning writer and real consumer; if absent, implement the smallest contract, daemon writer, and client edge rather than a fixture/helper substitute.
A real MCP boundary test submits distinct goal briefs and reads back each exact normalized title/instructions bound to a distinct durable goal/ref.
Caller cannot choose actor, project, run, or authority fields; hostile extras refuse with exact reason code and DAEMON_INGRESS layer.
Retry with the same authenticated request is idempotent; a conflicting retry refuses deterministically.
Contract, daemon, and client package tests run standalone with nonzero counts.
taskRails: User prose must become goal-bound durable state, not localStorage-only advisory data.
Do not reuse one hard-coded live run for all created goals.
No demo/fixture backend can discharge this production task.
